long_biography.plain_text:
Brian Lunsford left television production in his twenties and spent time on St John with his brother Brandon before returning to Georgia to pursue a business plan. The brothers bought their father’s pest-control and home-inspection company, built its website and strengthened customer communication and marketing. While the operation was small, Lunsford worked as a technician, inspector, salesperson and customer-service representative.

The brothers sold the Georgia pest-control division to ServiceMaster in 2019 but retained the inspection business and their Florida pest-control operation. Lunsford subsequently developed a group of complementary companies with his wife, Kristin. Alongside LunsPro and Kingfish Pest Control, their portfolio now includes real-estate publishing, seasonal lighting and home-repair services, brought together under Bring the Joy Ventures.
